about: The sapatos bank: the shoes. A place, who Buloy is there, the moment of pressure, who arrives (the bisita) and the stake prop that sits on frame 0. 'set' names a set in src/sets/ when one exists (a reused set is the cheapest episode); 'new' means a builder session, 'small' a new room built from existing assets. 'frame' is how fast a stranger reads the place at frame 0 (0 to 2); 'wild' is how far from daily life it is (0 to 2: an astronaut or a fisherman is wilder than a store). 'season' is a window (MM-DD to MM-DD) in which the place is in the news of people's lives. 'watch' is what the staging must respect. 'best_with' names the shortcuts were judged most natural in these shoes; tools/ideas.py ranks them first, and any other shortcut whose home tag the shoes share comes after.
